enchantments.tooltip: +4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.

Sneak Attack Bonus +2 : Provides a +2 Enhancement modifier to your attack bonus and a +3 Enhancement bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.
Armor-Piercing 10%: Passive: +10% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
